name: Wooden Cart
Description: A simple two-wheeled wooden cart pulled by a single horse. Basic but reliable transport for short trips.

name: Merchant Carriage
Description: A covered four-wheeled carriage with padded seats and a hidden storage compartment beneath the floorboards.

name: War Chariot
Special Ability: Trampling (deals damage to enemies in path)
Description: A reinforced bronze chariot with scythed wheels, drawn by two trained warhorses.

name: Ironclad Coach
Description: A heavily armored stagecoach plated with riveted iron sheets. Slow but nearly indestructible.

name: Enchanted Wagon
Description: A brightly painted wagon that moves on its own through low-level enchantment. Popular with traveling performers.

name: Beast of Burden Mount
Description: A massive armored ox with reinforced saddle and cargo racks. Handles any terrain without slowing down.

name: Siege Ram Cart
Special Ability: Breaking Force (deals massive damage to structures)
Description: A wheeled platform carrying a massive iron-tipped battering ram. Used to breach castle gates and walls.

name: Phantom Stagecoach
Description: A ghostly black coach that phases through walls and obstacles. Driven by an undead coachman who never speaks.

name: Fishing Rowboat
Description: A small wooden rowboat with oars and a fishing net. Common in coastal villages and lakeside towns.

name: Trading Galley
Special Ability: Cargo hold (stores large amounts of goods)
Description: A mid-sized merchant vessel with a single mast, cargo hold below deck, and room for a small crew.

name: War Galleon
Description: A three-masted warship bristling with cannons. The flagship of many naval fleets.

name: Kraken Hunter
Special Ability: Anti-monster harpoons (bonus damage to sea creatures)
Description: A reinforced vessel with harpoon launchers and chain nets designed specifically for hunting sea monsters.

name: Ghost Ship
Special Ability: Curse (nearby ships lose crew to fear)
Description: A decaying warship crewed by skeleton sailors. Glows with an eerie green light and appears from nowhere.

name: Leviathan's Bane
Special Ability: Leviathan Shield (immunizes against sea monster attacks)
Description: A legendary vessel forged from dragon scales and mithril. Said to be unsinkable in any ocean.

name: Hot Air Balloon
Special Ability: Aerial view (spot enemies from far away)
Description: A colorful fabric balloon suspended above a wicker basket. Moves with the wind but offers great visibility.

name: Scout Glider
Description: A lightweight wooden frame with stretched canvas wings. Launched from high points and glides on thermal currents.

name: Merchant Airship
Description: A gas-filled envelope above a wooden gondola with cargo nets hanging beneath. Slow but reliable for trade routes.

name: Dragon's Wing
Description: A sleek airship shaped like a dragon in flight, with articulated wings that flap for propulsion.

name: Stormrider Zeppelin
Special Ability: Thunder Ram (electrified ram on the bow)
Description: A massive armored airship with a lightning rod at its prow. Can generate and direct electrical storms.

name: Flying Carpet
Description: An ornate silk carpet that hovers and flies at the rider's command. Embroidered with ancient runes that glow during flight.

name: Portal Stone Sled
Description: A stone platform that teleports in bursts of blue light. Each blink covers 100 meters but requires a cooldown.

name: Phoenix Chariot
Description: A golden chariot pulled by a pair of fire birds. Burns with perpetual flame but never scorches its riders.

name: World Turtle Barge
Description: A platform built upon the shell of an ancient, continent-sized turtle. Moves slowly but carries an entire village.

name: Astral Skiff
Description: A translucent boat that sails through the astral plane. Used by planar travelers and extraplanar merchants.
